## Type

- [ ] New content entry
- [ ] Content fix / improvement
- [ ] Explorer feature or bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-content.js` passes locally
- [ ] Content has no em-dashes or en-dashes (`—` `–`); used commas / colons / periods
- [ ] Table cell pipes are escaped as `\|`
- [ ] New badges have a `--badge-<id>` token (dark **and** light) plus a `.tree-badge--<id>` rule
- [ ] Checked it in the browser by serving `site/`
